review.notes: Full token-level diff of all 36 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown (case/punctuation normalized), plus structural fence/heading scan; pages 4, 12, 13 and reference crops of pages 32 and 36 were rendered and visually inspected. No code fences exist in the source, so no swallowed-structure risk. The OCR interleaves Figure 8's thumbnail grid with the section 4.2 category prose (reading-order noise, not droppage); the two bold figure-region labels were demoted while thumbnail captions were left in place. The DexMimicGen data-pipeline paragraph, all reference entries and contributor lists are present; apparent drops in the diff were figure-internal diagram/prompt/legend text already shown by the embedded figure images (verified on renders of pages 9, 13 and 22 region).
